title: Clair de lune
instructions: At a walking pace, with expression.

source.name: Mutopia Project
source.reference: Mutopia-2010/12/21-1778; Keith OHara, typeset from E. Fromont (1905), Plate E.1404 F. Complete 72-measure piano movement. LilyPond source retained at sources/debussy-clair-de-lune/clair-de-lune.ly. Demo tempo chosen as quarter note = 75 BPM (dotted quarter = 50); the source specifies Andante très expressif without a metronome mark.

annotations.text: Gradually get louder and more animated.
